driverFormulas.rev: Total Operating Income = Interest & Fee Income − Interest & Fee Expense
driverFormulas.cogs: Impairment Charge (IFRS 9 ECL) = Stage 1/2 Movement + Stage 3 Provisions + Overlays
driverFormulas.gp: Income after Impairment = Operating Income − Impairment
driverFormulas.gp-pct: Income after Impairment % = GP / Operating Income x 100
driverFormulas.opex-excl: Operating Costs = Origination & Distribution + Technology & Data + Operations, Risk & Corporate
driverFormulas.ebitda-pct: Pre-Depreciation Margin % = Pre-Depreciation Profit / Operating Income x 100
driverFormulas.ebit-pct: Operating Margin % = Operating Profit / Operating Income x 100
driverFormulas.nonop: Fair Value & Derecognition Items = FVTPL + Derecognition + Other
driverFormulas.ebt: Profit before Tax = Operating Profit + Fair Value Items
driverFormulas.ni-pct: Net Profit Margin % = PAT / Operating Income x 100
driverFormulas.bs-assets: Total Assets = Lending & Liquidity Assets + Other Assets
driverFormulas.bs-ca: Lending & Liquidity Assets = Cash + Loans + Liquid Assets + Other
driverFormulas.bs-inv: Liquid Assets (BoE Reserves, Gilts, T-Bills) = BoE Reserves + Gilts & T-Bills + Bank Placements
driverFormulas.bs-nca: Fixed, Intangible & Other Assets = Equipment + Accum. Depreciation + Intangibles + Other
driverFormulas.bs-liab-eq: Total Liabilities & Equity = Deposits & Funding + Other Liabilities + Equity
driverFormulas.bs-cl: Deposits & Central Bank Funding = Deposits & ILTR + Accruals + Derivatives + Other
driverFormulas.bs-ncl: Capital Instruments & Other Liabilities = Tier 2 + Tax + Provisions
driverFormulas.bs-equity: Total Equity = Share Capital & AT1 + Retained Earnings + Reserves
driverFormulas.cfo: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = PAT + D&A + Balance Sheet Movements
driverFormulas.cfi: Cash Flow from Investing Activities = Technology Investment + Disposals + Other
driverFormulas.cff: Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Tier 2 / Central Bank + AT1 + Coupons
driverFormulas.cf-net: Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
driverFormulas.cf-end-cash: Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
